resources.string: Pairing could not be removed (storage full?): %1$s
TV connection failed. Open both apps and select the TV again.
TV unreachable: this phone is not on the same network. Join the TV\'s Wi-Fi or enable VPN access under Availability and network.
Local network unavailable. Check network permission and Wi-Fi or Ethernet.
Invalid invitation. Scan a new QR code on the TV.
Cannot play this item on the TV. Check that the same media source is configured there.
The phone wants to play a title from %1$s, which is not the active server on this TV.
Share exactly one YouTube link or direct HTTP(S) media link, such as MP4, M3U8, MP3 or FLAC. Web pages and local files are not supported.
This TV target is no longer paired. Please pair it again.
On the TV, open Settings → Phone & TV → Pair device. Then pick the TV below and enter the code from its screen — or scan its QR code with your phone camera and open it in Ambient TV.
Scan with your phone camera, or enter the code below in Ambient TV on the phone. Valid for two minutes. Then compare the codes on both devices.
Compare the code on both devices. Only confirm if both codes match.
%1$s · enter the code shown on this TV
Enter the eight-character code from the TV screen.
Wrong pairing code. Please try again.
Too many wrong codes. Open pairing on the TV again.
Point the camera at the QR code on the TV.
Camera access is needed to scan the code. You can also enter the code from the TV instead.
The camera could not be opened. Please enter the code from the TV instead.
Playback did not start in time.
The saved queue could not be loaded.
The queue is still available, but could not be saved for a restart.
Looking for TVs on this Wi-Fi …
No TV found. Open Ambient TV on the TV, turn on Settings → Phone & TV → Allow connections on this TV, and keep both devices on the same Wi-Fi.
Allow access to the home network so the phone can find and reach the TV.
To link a TV, enter the code it shows under Settings → Phone & TV → Pair device.
